items.description: Resgrid is a cloud management and logistics platform built specifically for first responder teams. They offer mobile apps to track the real time status of phone responders and geo-locate units in the field. The tools are made specifically for volunteer, search and rescue, fire, and disaster response organizations. Resgrid additionally offers access to it's core API for users to integrate the Resgrid service into 3rd party applications.
TodoToday Pro for Teambox is a task list application to show current todo items from the online collaboration and project management tool Teambox

A real estate search engine that aggregating nearly a million property listings searchable with a GoogleMap-based visual interface. Site has budding online community of buyers, sellers, and service providers.
mygoogleplus.com uses Google+ API to transform user profile into a Facebook style timeline.
Learn about the unknown hazards around you - the toxins you may be breathing. PlanetHazard maps over 86,000 companies throughout the US that emit hazardous air pollutants. Excellent mashup.

A job search engine and web mashup that incorporates Google Maps to see the location of an employer, LinkedIn to see which of your contacts works at the job location, and Payscale to see current salary analysis by job category.
A visually rich interactive Flash tool for exploring place based on the geotagged photos at Flickr. Search by user, tag and collection.

Dunkathon is a HotOrNot version of basketball dunking clips. Videos are retrieved by filtering clips from YouTube API and only keep the ones that are relevant to dunking and short in length, 40 sec or less.
Allows Box.net users to send files from their Box accounts to Fuze Meeting, where they can discuss and collaborate around them with other users.
The Ewi - Pewter is the music streaming radio real-time search service. You can find radio stations that streams the music, by entering artist name.
Get news, ratings, game schedules and rumors for NBA teams plotted on a map.
GeoImpress provides a completely new way to search for places all over the world. Integrates Google Maps, Flickr, and Twitter.
Lets people know the best way to get from A to B in Dublin using just the public transportation. Access over 5000 stops, with more coming. Also available in multiple languages.

WordPress meets google maps and panoramio photos to create a new way of discovering all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico. Caribbean Resorts Mashup - a free informational resource of all inclusive resorts from Mexico, Cuba and Dominican Republic. It brings in one place, the resorts details, quick access to reviews, aerial views maps, Panoramio photos and YouTube videos.
Large network of virtual tours and spherical virtual reality photography. More than 50 cities from all over the world with thousands of high-resolution interactive panoramas.
Health and fitness facts, terms, tips, information, websites, and knowledge in a Google Gadget. Get an interesting reference devoted to making you healthier, more fit, and more happy.
Real-time polling mashup. People can ask questions and watch the answers come in real-time, with geographic locations.

See where your ocean container shipment is via real-time maps on SeaRates. Helps freight forwarders and logistics companies to perform global shipping operations with international container shipments.

Moveboxer is the best way to find a reputable mover and instantly get a quote for your move. Moveboxer combines Yelp ratings and reviews with a price estimate so users have more information along the way and can select the movers of their choice to get in touch with them.
View stores, beaches, apartments, and other French data on a Google map. Lets you select a place to live near places of interest. Click an item to view photographs of the places.
Dubtune uses YouTube, Soundcloud and Last.fm to create a Dubstep listening platform for fans of the genre. Soundcloud and Youtube are used as the basis for media streaming and Last.fm for meta data.
Map search to locate Recycling Centers and a guide to recycling from home. There is also a store to shop for recycling stuff.
